title: docs: sandboxes run 8 at once per account
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Corrected the sandbox docs to say that up to 8 sandboxes can run concurrently per account, rather than 3. The documented limit now matches MAX_RUNNING_PER_USER; no runtime behavior changed.

Polli, the main character, is a small cute pixel art bee with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on her cheeks, a small happy smile, small rounded light blue translucent wings, and tiny librarian glasses; strictly pixel art, never realistic, in a cozy 8-bit aesthetic.
